program_overview: 36-Week Workforce Development, Advanced Manufacturing & National Certification Preparation
Design It. Build It. Automate It. Inspect It. Improve It. Manufacture the Future.

The Automotive Manufacturing Technology Program is a comprehensive 36-week career and technical education program designed to prepare students for entry-level employment, apprenticeships, postsecondary technical education, and applicable industry certification examinations within automotive and advanced manufacturing.
Unlike an automotive service/repair program, this curriculum concentrates on how automobiles and automotive components are manufactured.
Students learn the complete manufacturing process—from raw materials and engineering drawings to machining, robotics, assembly, quality control, automation, and final production.
